newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P upgrades Indosuez Australia, New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: S&P upgrades Indosuez Australia, New Zealand.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Thursday it had upgraded Indosuez Australia Ltd's long term rating to AA from A plus and its short term rating to A1 plus from A1.
S&P also raised its long and short term ratings on Bank Indosuez (New Zealand branch) by the same increment.
The move follows S&P's upgrade of the parent, Banque Indosuez, to AA from A plus early this week.
The ratings were removed from creditwatch, where they were placed on December 24, 1996. S&P said the ratings outlook was stable. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
